_meta.status: PROPOSAL. Not wired into missions/. Developers implement from the doc.
_meta.rules: Every dialogue text is 80 characters or fewer and uses the {name} token for the player. Every event has label History, Tradition or Invented, plus a year or Legend.
_meta.proposedFields: Every field that starts with x_ is NEW and PROPOSED. Existing fields keep their current shape. objectives[] gains x_type and x_optional. Checkpoints move out of objectives into x_respawns (respawn points only).

styleSources.note: Each source counts up to 6 points per level.

_meta.rankRule: Bronze: finish. Silver: finish and meet two of three (time under silver, 3 hits or fewer, style at silver). Gold: all three at gold (time under gold, 0 hits, style at gold).
_meta.parNote: All times, hit limits and style numbers are starting guesses. Tune them in playtest.

missions.title: Escape from Hastinapur
missions.logline: Spears in the Lamp Bazaar. Carry the grain plea out of the city before dawn.

objectives.text: Get the plea out the east gate by dawn
Make Captain Kunjara yield at the canal bridge
Keep the child's lantern lit
Cut the bell rope before it rings
Shove three spearmen into the canal

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Take the plea, {name}. Run. The bridge bell rings soon.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: Five roads, then home. This is the first.

dialogue.speaker: Spearman
dialogue.text: Courier! Stop there!

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Slip sideways from the spear. Then shove.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Stall roofs hold. Climb when the lane is full.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Grey cords on their wrists. That is not the city watch.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: Shields now. Shove, do not strike.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: The crowd is thick. Use it. Keep the plea flat!

dialogue.speaker: Kunjara
dialogue.text: The bridge is shut. Hand over the plea.

dialogue.speaker: Kunjara
dialogue.text: Bell! Bring every spear!

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: The rope! Climb the post and cut it!

dialogue.speaker: Kunjara
dialogue.text: My shield is split. Still I stand.

dialogue.speaker: Kunjara
dialogue.text: Enough. I yield. Go.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Up! Keep moving. The plea is safe.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: The lantern still burns. Good.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Again, {name}. The plea can wait a breath.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Dandaka
dialogue.text: Open the gate. Those fields feed my kin too.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: No glory in this. Just a road that stayed open.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Take this lamp. I will speak through it.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Not one scratch. Lamp-Runner, indeed.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Someone hunts couriers, {name}. Keep walking.

missions.x_hook: A spear hits the lamp post by your head. Run.
missions.x_first10s: Night. Suvrata presses the plea into your hands. A spear thuds into the stall beside you. Control is yours at once.
missions.x_stake: The plea feeds the farm villages. Suvrata trusts you with it. It is your first of five roads home.
missions.x_pressure: Dawn bar (lamps burn out). The canal bridge lifts at the bell.
missions.x_signature: Shove: push through crowds and shove spears and shields aside.

x_respawns.note: respawn only, not shown as a goal

x_encounters.name: Lamp rows
x_encounters.teaches: shove breaks a shield; climb a stall roof

x_setPiece.name: The lantern chase
beats: Three spearmen pour into the lane.
Run through the crowd; shove a cart to block them.
Vault stalls; the bell begins to toll.
Reach the bridge before it lifts.

x_boss.name: Captain Kunjara
x_boss.role: Shield captain of the Hunt, a mini boss

phases.name: Wall
phases.counter: Dodge to the side; shove while he recovers

phases.name: Bell
phases.tell: He swings for the alarm rope; two spearmen join
phases.counter: Climb the post and cut the rope; dodge the spearmen
phases.ends: rope cut or bell rings once

phases.name: Split shield
phases.counter: Parry or dodge, then one clean shove into the canal shallows
phases.ends: he yields and sits on the bridge step

x_cliffhanger.speaker: Suvrata
x_cliffhanger.beat: A torch on the far bank goes out.

missions.title: The Night Report of Pataliputra
missions.logline: A thief takes the ferry clerk's report. Steal it back and beat the flood.

objectives.text: Take the report back from the thief
Reach the sluice house and beat Night Captain Ghora
Lead the porter out of the flooded lane
Cross the palisade lane unseen
Jam the watch drum so it cannot sound

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata (lamp)
dialogue.text: Rain, {name}. Good cover. Good luck.

dialogue.speaker: Vasuka
dialogue.text: He took the report! Get it back, {name}!

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: Rain, dark, one thief. Easy.

dialogue.speaker: Revati
dialogue.text: Crouch in shadow. The watch sees what moves.

dialogue.speaker: Revati
dialogue.text: Snatch from behind. Quiet hands win here.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: Got it. Now the wall, before the water.

dialogue.speaker: Revati
dialogue.text: Lantern swings left. Go right.

dialogue.speaker: Revati
dialogue.text: Two blades and a shield. Wait for the turn.

dialogue.speaker: Revati
dialogue.text: The posts are going! Climb, {name}, climb!

dialogue.speaker: Ghora
dialogue.text: Courier. The report stays here.

dialogue.speaker: Ghora
dialogue.text: Quick hands. Now quick feet.

dialogue.speaker: Ghora
dialogue.text: The water is up. Finish it.

dialogue.speaker: Ghora
dialogue.text: I do not fight a flood. Go.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: Seen! Break their line of sight.

dialogue.speaker: Revati
dialogue.text: Breathe. Back into the shadow.

dialogue.speaker: Revati
dialogue.text: The watch turns at the drum. We go again.

dialogue.speaker: Overseer Kshema
dialogue.text: A jammed sluice, not a plot. Wake the timber crews!

dialogue.speaker: Revati
dialogue.text: Never seen, never hit. Quiet Foot.

dialogue.speaker: Overseer Kshema
dialogue.text: A note in the pouch: 'Turn back, courier. U.'

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata (lamp)
dialogue.text: Ulka. He knows your road. Keep walking.

missions.x_hook: Vasuka falls. The report is gone. Take it back.
missions.x_first10s: Rain on the wharf. A swordsman snatches the pouch and runs. Chase him down the planks and grab it back.
missions.x_stake: A flood warning for the wall. Hundreds sleep behind it. Vasuka trusted you.
missions.x_pressure: River gauge rising at the sluice. Watch lanterns sweep the lane.
missions.x_signature: Crouch in shadow, then snatch from behind.

x_encounters.name: Palisade lane
x_encounters.teaches: doubled watch; parry window on swordsmen

x_setPiece.name: The palisade gives way
beats: The flood loosens a stretch of posts.
Posts fall behind you in a rolling line.
Climb the leaning timbers; do not stop.
Leap the gap to the sluice walk.

x_boss.name: Night Captain Ghora
x_boss.role: Swordsman captain of the Hunt, a mini boss

phases.name: Chain
phases.tell: Three-slash chain, long pause on the third

phases.name: Lamp throw
phases.tell: He hurls an oil lamp; a small flame patch lights the planks
phases.counter: Dodge the lamp; fight off the flame patch

phases.name: Rising water
phases.tell: Water covers the walk; he fights faster
phases.counter: Shove him against the rail at the right moment
phases.ends: he drops his blade and clings to the rail

x_cliffhanger.speaker: Overseer Kshema
x_cliffhanger.text: A note in the pouch: 'Turn back, courier. U.'
x_cliffhanger.beat: The lamp flame leans toward the hills.

missions.title: The Pepper Road
missions.logline: A rope bridge snaps. Guard the caravan and its pepper to the harbour before the tide.

objectives.text: Bring the caravan master and three sacks to the harbour
Win the duel on the ledge against Captain Karuman
Bring all three sacks undamaged
Pull Karuman back up the ledge
Reach the harbour without an arrow hit

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata (lamp)
dialogue.text: Hills, {name}. Mind the stream.

dialogue.speaker: Caravan master
dialogue.text: The bridge! Hold the line, {name}!

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: Take my staff. It is a longer arm. Keep trouble at its length.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: Sweep low to turn a spear. Plant it to steady a rope.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: Spears have reach. Your staff has more.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: Archer on the rock! Dodge when he draws.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: One sack safe. Two to go.

dialogue.speaker: Caravan master
dialogue.text: They want my pepper! Keep them off!

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: The ledge is narrow. Mind your feet first.

dialogue.speaker: Karuman
dialogue.text: Staff against spear. Brave, courier.

dialogue.speaker: Karuman
dialogue.text: I cut the rope! Fall, or fight!

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: Plant the staff. Hold the ledge steady!

dialogue.speaker: Karuman
dialogue.text: My foot! The stone is gone!

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: Grab the staff! I have you!

dialogue.speaker: Karuman
dialogue.text: You pulled me up. Why?

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: A road is for walking, not falling.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: Feet first, then the staff.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: The tide waits. We start the road again.

dialogue.speaker: Harbour clerk
dialogue.text: Three sacks, sealed. Keep that staff. It is yours.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: Not a sack lost, not a mark on you. Staff-Bearer.

dialogue.speaker: Ulka
dialogue.text: You pulled him up. Nobody pulled me up, {name}.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata (lamp)
dialogue.text: He is close now. The next road burns.

missions.x_hook: A rope bridge snaps. Catch the master's hand.
missions.x_first10s: Hill stream. The caravan is mid-bridge when an arrow cuts the rope. Climb down and catch the master before he falls.
missions.x_stake: The pepper is a hill village's winter pay. Poonkodi lent you her staff and her trust.
missions.x_pressure: Evening tide at the harbour scales. A sack lost is pay lost.
missions.x_signature: Staff: sweep to keep distance, plant to steady a rope or a ledge.

x_encounters.name: Goat path
x_encounters.teaches: archer tell; dodge, then close in

x_setPiece.name: The ledge over the stream
beats: The last stretch is a narrow rock ledge.
Karuman blocks it with a long spear.
Ulka watches from the far bank.
The ledge crumbles under them.

x_boss.name: Captain Karuman
x_boss.role: Long-spear captain of the Hunt. The duel is the set piece.

phases.name: Point
phases.tell: Spear drawn back, then a long thrust
phases.counter: Dodge, step inside the point, sweep his legs with the staff

phases.name: Rope
phases.tell: He cuts a rope; the ledge sways
phases.counter: Plant the staff to steady yourself, then strike

phases.name: Slip
phases.tell: A stone gives way; he slides toward the drop
phases.counter: Hold out the staff and pull him up (mercy) or let him slide to the lower rock

x_cliffhanger.speaker: Ulka
x_cliffhanger.text: You pulled him up. Nobody pulled me up, {name}.
x_cliffhanger.beat: Ulka on the far bank. His lamp matches yours.

missions.title: The Forge Road
missions.logline: Fire at the forge gate. Hold it until dawn so the village bridge gets its nails.

objectives.text: Hold the gate until dawn
Turn back all three waves
Make Captain Shaila yield
Cut the ram rope
Keep the bellows going
Land three parries

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata (lamp)
dialogue.text: Smoke ahead, {name}. Sparks too.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Fire at the gate! Take this blade, {name}!

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Block, then answer. Parry as the blow lands.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Spears first. Step in past the point.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Shields next. A parry breaks their guard.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Archers on the shed. Climb and shove them into the hay.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: The bar is cracking! Hold the gate, {name}!

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: The bellows still breathe. Good.

dialogue.speaker: Shaila
dialogue.text: Break the gate! The courier is mine.

dialogue.speaker: Shaila
dialogue.text: Shields up! A wall of iron!

dialogue.speaker: Shaila
dialogue.text: Dawn is near. One more blow!

dialogue.speaker: Shaila
dialogue.text: I yield. Ulka said your road ends in a flood.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Breathe. Block first, always.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: The forge is still warm. Again, {name}.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: A sword sheathed has done its best work. Sheathe it.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: No harm, no haste. Sheath-Keeper.

dialogue.speaker: Shaila
dialogue.text: Ask Ulka who he lost to the flood.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata (lamp)
dialogue.text: Do not ask him. Not yet. Walk.

missions.x_hook: The forge gate is burning. Take the blade.
missions.x_first10s: Night at the forge. A ram thumps the gate. Ayasa throws you a blade and a spearman is already through the smoke.
missions.x_stake: The bridge nails must be finished by dawn or the village cannot cross the river. Ayasa risks the forge for you.
missions.x_pressure: Dawn bar; gate bar health; bellows heat that cools if left alone.
missions.x_signature: Sword parry: block just as the blow lands, and a spark of iron answers.

x_encounters.name: Gate wave 3
x_encounters.teaches: climb the shed; shove archers off

x_setPiece.name: Hold the gate until dawn
beats: The gate bar cracks under the ram.
Waves arrive in three bursts.
Pump the bellows between waves.
The dawn bell rings; the Hunt falls back.

x_boss.name: Captain Shaila
x_boss.role: Heavy-shield captain of the Hunt, boss

phases.name: Ram
phases.tell: She orders the ram; the gate shudders
phases.counter: Cut the ram rope with your sword

phases.name: Wall
phases.tell: She and a shield bearer stand shoulder to shoulder
phases.counter: Parry to break the guard, then strike the shield bearer first

phases.name: Last blows
phases.counter: Dodge, then parry the final chop
phases.ends: she yields at the dawn bell

x_reward.title: Sheath-Keeper
x_reward.note: Bow moves to level 5. The existing gupta-forge JSON grants bow; that grant should move.

x_cliffhanger.speaker: Shaila
x_cliffhanger.text: Ask Ulka who he lost to the flood.
x_cliffhanger.beat: A grey cord lies on the road, tied to a lamp like yours.

missions.title: The Tank and the Sluice
missions.logline: A flood night. The watch tower burns. Open the sluice and save the boat.

objectives.text: Shoot a line to the stranded boat and draw it ashore
Stand against Ulka at the bund
Leave the burning tower
Cut the Hunt's oil-jar rope
Bring Tamarai down safe
Hit every target with one arrow

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata (lamp)
dialogue.text: Water ahead, {name}. A lot of it.

dialogue.speaker: Tamarai
dialogue.text: Fire on the tower! Take the bow, {name}!

dialogue.speaker: Tamarai
dialogue.text: Breathe out. Hold. Let go.

dialogue.speaker: Tamarai
dialogue.text: Aim at rope and flag, never at a person.

dialogue.speaker: Tamarai
dialogue.text: Archers on the steps. Keep low and move.

dialogue.speaker: Tamarai
dialogue.text: Shield and blades on the bund. Parry, then shove.

dialogue.speaker: Tamarai
dialogue.text: The sluice rope! Shoot it, then climb down!

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: Rope cut. The water is running. Go go go!

dialogue.speaker: Ulka
dialogue.text: Five roads, courier. The fifth drowns.

dialogue.speaker: Ulka
dialogue.text: Run back. The water is not kind.

dialogue.speaker: Ulka
dialogue.text: A boat. A child. Not again.

dialogue.speaker: Ulka
dialogue.text: I carried five. The fifth drowned my village.

dialogue.speaker: Tamarai
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe, then loose.

dialogue.speaker: Tamarai
dialogue.text: The tank will wait. Try again, {name}.

dialogue.speaker: Tamarai
dialogue.text: The boat is ashore. All hands. Well shot.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Ulka was my courier before you. I sent him.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Home waits for one who leaves. The roads need one who stays.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: You said five roads, then home.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: I did. Forgive me.

dialogue.speaker: Tamarai
dialogue.text: Every arrow true. Tank-Watcher.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: No glory in this. Just a road that stayed open.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Your door is open. So is a road where a river rises.

missions.x_hook: A fire arrow hits the tower. Shoot the rope.
missions.x_first10s: Flood night at the tank. A burning arrow thuds into the tower roof. Tamarai hands you a bow and a target rope appears.
missions.x_stake: A boat of strangers is stranded in the swollen channel. The bund may overtop. Ulka is here and he knows your road.
missions.x_pressure: Fire climbs the tower; the water gauge rises on the bund.
missions.x_signature: Bow: hold the draw, breathe, loose at rope and flag.

x_setPiece.name: The burning tower
beats: Archers set the watch tower alight.
Climb up to the sluice-rope window as stairs burn.
Shoot the rope to open the sluice; the flood douses the flames.
Slide down the scaffold to the bund.

x_boss.name: Ulka
x_boss.role: The rival. Spear and torch. Final boss of this arc, and the turn.

phases.name: Torch and spear
phases.tell: Torch swing then a thrust; he feints
phases.counter: Parry the thrust, dodge the torch

phases.name: Fire arrows
phases.tell: He leaps to the bund and shoots flaming arrows
phases.counter: Shoot his lamp rope; use cover; close in

phases.name: The boat
phases.tell: A child cries from the stranded boat; he hesitates
phases.counter: Do not strike. Shoot a line to the boat; Ulka helps haul it
phases.ends: the boat is ashore and Ulka lowers his spear

x_cliffhanger.speaker: Suvrata
x_cliffhanger.text: Your door is open. So is a road where a river rises.
x_cliffhanger.beat: Two lights: a door of home, and a lamp road by a dark river.

missions.x_turn: Ulka carried a fifth plea that ended in a flood and a lost village. Suvrata sent him, as she sent {name}. The way home opens at the fifth road, but only for one who leaves it shut.
